summary: Iteration 103 - Verified MO-driven MRP demand feature (Fix 1). All 5 new tests passed + 19 regression tests from iteration 99/102 passed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_MRP_103_ prefixed items during tests, all cleaned up after each test class
context_for_next_testing_agent: MO-driven MRP demand feature verified working. The /api/mrp/demand endpoint now sources demand from work_orders (MOs) instead of production_orders (SOs). SOs without MOs generate NO demand. Variant-aware MRP demand also works correctly.

backend.details: Created SO for 5 FG but NO MO. Called /mrp/demand. Verified NO demand for RM (because no MO exists yet). This confirms SOs alone don't generate MRP demand.
Created MO for qty=5 FG. Called /mrp/demand. Verified 10 units demand for RM (5 FG × 2 RM per FG). This confirms MOs generate MRP demand.
Created MO and reserved materials (with shortfall since RM stock=0). Called /mrp/demand. Verified shortfall is captured in net_requirement > 0.

Created MTS MO without SO (production_order_id=null). Verified MO has no production_order_id. Called /mrp/demand. Verified demand increased by 6 units (3 FG × 2 RM per FG). This confirms MTS MOs without SOs still appear in MRP demand.

Created RM with variants (Grit=16GT,30GT), generated variant children. Created MO with variant_selection={Grit:30GT}. Called /mrp/demand. Verified demand is against RM-30GT (variant child), not RM (parent). This confirms variant-aware MRP demand works.

regression.details: All 15 variant inheritance tests passed - no regression
All 4 variant consumption tests passed - no regression

features_verified.mo_driven_mrp_demand: MRP demand is now sourced from MOs (work_orders) instead of SOs (production_orders)
features_verified.so_without_mo_no_demand: SOs without MOs generate NO MRP demand (SOs only show intent, not commitment)
features_verified.mts_mo_in_demand: MTS MOs without SOs (production_order_id=null) still appear in MRP demand
features_verified.reserved_mo_shortfall: Reserved MO shortfalls are captured in MRP demand
features_verified.variant_aware_mrp: MO with variant_selection generates demand against variant child SKU, not parent

code_review_notes.server.py_lines_2511-2700: calculate_demand endpoint now queries work_orders (MOs) with status pending/in_progress, materials_reserved!=true, parent_wo_id=null. Uses _resolve_variant_child_item for variant-aware explosion.
